jobs.title: Image Processing Engineer
jobs.description:
The Image Processing Engineer is a technical contributor within the Machine-Readable Features Laboratory , supporting the development, integration, validation, and optimization of image processing and computer vision algorithms used in machine-readable authentication and traceability systems.

The role covers a broad range of technologies including image analysis, machine vision, computer vision, optical sensing, signal processing, and machine learning techniques applied to advanced security features. The position combines algorithm development, software implementation, data analysis, system integration, and experimental validation in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams including optics, electronics, chemistry, software engineering, and data science.

This position is well suited for an engineer seeking to build deep expertise in image processing, industrial machine vision, and authentication technologies, while contributing to innovative security solutions from concept through industrial deployment.

ROLE

• Develop, implement, and optimize image processing and computer vision algorithms for machine-readable authentication systems.

• Design and evaluate algorithms for feature detection, classification, segmentation, pattern recognition, and image enhancement.

• Analyze large image datasets to extract meaningful information and improve feature detectability and robustness.

• Support the development of algorithms for optical inspection, authentication, traceability, and quality control applications.

• Collaborate with optics, electronics, and software teams to integrate image processing solutions into embedded and industrial systems.

• Perform experimental testing, validation, and benchmarking of algorithms under varying operational and environmental conditions.

• Document algorithms, test results, and technical studies through reports, specifications, and presentations.

• Contribute to technology scouting, literature reviews, and the evaluation of emerging image processing and computer vision technologies.

• Actively collaborate within multidisciplinary project teams composed of scientists, chemists, optics engineers, electronics engineers, and software developers.

PROFILE

Education & Experience

• Master’s degree in Computer Vision, Image Processing , or equivalent. Relevant experience in the specific field.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of image processing and computer vision techniques.

• Experience with Python and/or C/C++ for algorithm development and optimization.

• Proficient in AI-powered image processing, object detection, segmentation, OCR, and computer vision using PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO, and multimodal LLM technologies.Strong understanding of machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques applied to image analysis and pattern recognition.

• Experience developing, training, validating, and deploying deep learning models for image classification, object detection, segmentation, feature extraction, and anomaly detection.

• Comfortable using data analysis and visualization tools for algorithm evaluation and reporting.

Personal Skills

• Curious, motivated, and eager to develop deep technical expertise .

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset.

• Increasingly autonomous, with the ability to manage laboratory tasks with limited supervision.

• Reliable, structured, and quality‑oriented.

• Team player in a multicultural and interdisciplinary environment .

Languages

• Good working knowledge of English and French  (spoken and written).

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

• Monitor project actuals against planned budgets and escalate risks where appropriate.

jobs.description:
For the development of our core strategic solutions, we are currently looking for a very experienced, top motivated, hands-on:

TECHNICAL COORDINATOR (SOFTWARE / AUTOMATION)

The Technical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and driving the validation of industrial software and/or automation solutions for our coding machines. The role combines strong technical expertise, delivery accountability, and cross-functional coordination, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and continuous improvement of both processes and solutions.

Role :

• Drive coordination Software release validation for our industrial inhouse coding machines

• Plan, coordinate, and monitor validation and release activities for customer-specific customizations.

• Actively manage planning, risks, technical dependencies, and delivery constraints, taking corrective actions through replanning, reprioritization, or mitigation when required.

• Investigate and solve technical dependencies with people in development teams, QA, deployment teams and operations. Assure availability of machines and material for validation.

• Plan and execute validation assuring operational readiness of coding machines at expected quality on the committed deadlines. Incorporate risks, constraints and dependencies into planning to be able to commit to a delivery date.

• Maintain a structured and transparent status of all ongoing validation activities

• Manage and follow up on incidents, problems, and change requests raised from operations or field technicians.

• Improve internal validation process and tooling for software release validation

• Promote and apply a continuous improvement mindset, simplifying processes, validation approaches, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, robustness, and time-to-market.

• Contribute to the software development of solution in Java

• Support activities both in the office and in the laboratory, including validation, commissioning, and operational support when required.

Profile :

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent).

• Minimum 2 years of experience in industrial or technical environments involving complex systems.

• Hands-on expertise in software development (industrial software, platforms, backend or custom applications)

• Good technical understanding of both software and industrial engineering domains, enabling effective coordination across multidisciplinary teams.

• Proven experience in delivery-driven environments, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, and risks.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills are key, with the ability to align stakeholders, facilitate collaboration, handle priorities, and address issues constructively.

• Ability to take a step back and maintain a global overview while remaining pragmatic and solution oriented.

• Comfortable working both in the office and on-site (support, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting).

• Proactive, reliable, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Curious and improvement-driven, continuously seeking to simplify processes and solutions.

• Fluent in English; Proficient in French; additional European languages are an asset.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Embedded Software Engineer is a technical contributor within the Machine-Readable Features Laboratory , supporting the development, integration, validation, and maintenance of embedded software solutions used in advanced machine-readable authentication and traceability systems.

The role covers a broad range of technologies including  real-time operating systems (RTOS), embedded Linux platforms, high-speed sensor systems, signal processing, System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures, and industrial software development frameworks . The position combines software architecture and development , system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities within a multidisciplinary environment involving electronics, optics, chemistry, data science, and software engineering.

This position is well suited for an engineer seeking to build strong expertise in embedded systems, industrial sensing technologies, and software lifecycle management, with opportunities to contribute from concept to deployment in cutting-edge security solutions.

ROLE

• Develop, maintain, and optimize embedded software applications in C/C++ for real-time and Linux-based platforms.

• Design, develop, and maintain software running on RTOS, embedded Linux, microcontrollers, microprocessors, DSPs, and System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms .

• Support the integration of embedded software with electronics, optics, and sensor subsystems.

• Design and execute software testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities to ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability.

• Investigate and resolve software defects, field issues, and system integration challenges.

• Contribute to software documentation, including requirements, design specifications, test reports, user documentation, and maintenance procedures.

• Participate in technical reviews, design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate actively within multidisciplinary project teams including electronics engineers, software engineers, physicists, chemists, and scientists.

PROFILE

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems , or equivalent.

Technical Skills

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming for embedded applications.

• Experience with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and embedded Linux environments.

• Knowledge of software testing methodologies , debugging techniques, and version control systems.

• Familiarity with System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures , including microprocessors, microcontrollers, and DSPs.

• Knowledge of communication interfaces and industrial embedded systems integration.

• Comfortable using standard engineering tools for software development, versioning, issue tracking, and technical documentation.

Personal Skills

• Curious, motivated, and eager to develop deep technical expertise .

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset.

• Increasingly autonomous, with the ability to manage laboratory tasks with limited supervision.

• Reliable, structured, and quality‑oriented.

• Team player in a multicultural and interdisciplinary environment .

Languages

• Good working knowledge of English and French  (spoken and written).

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

• Monitor project actuals against planned budgets and escalate risks where appropriate.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Giardiniere/a

Ruolo

Dipendente dal Caposquadra Paesaggista, il/la giardiniere/a si occupa quotidianamente della manutenzione degli spazi verdi e paesaggistici del sito di Prilly (aiuole fiorite, arbusti, prati, tappeti erbosi, arredi urbani). Il/la candidato/a trascorre la maggior parte del tempo sul campo e contribuisce direttamente alla qualità estetica e alla sicurezza degli esterni del sito.

Responsabilità e mansioni

- Manutenzione ordinaria: falciatura, potatura di siepi e arbusti, diserbo, irrigazione, raccolta di foglie e rifiuti verdi.
- Potatura specialistica: esecuzione autonoma di potature di formazione, sfoltimento e potature di ringiovanimento su diversi arbusti, piante perenni e siepi, nel rispetto dei cicli stagionali.
- Gestione del tappeto erboso e del suolo: diagnosi dei problemi del prato (muschio, malattie, feltro) ed esecuzione dei piani di manutenzione (scarificazione, fertilizzazione, risemina).
- Piantagioni: realizzazione e manutenzione di aiuole fiorite e vegetali secondo i piani definiti dal Caposquadra in accordo con il mandante paesaggista.
- Servizio invernale: partecipazione allo sgombero neve e al salatura delle strade e dei viali del sito.
- Manutenzione delle attrezzature: utilizzo sicuro di macchine e strumenti, manutenzione tecnica quotidiana (rasaerba, tagliasiepi, motoseghe, soffiatori, ecc.).
- Organizzazione efficace del cantiere: rispetto della pianificazione e riordino delle attrezzature, con restituzione di un sito pulito e sicuro a fine giornata.
- Sicurezza: rispetto rigoroso delle norme di sicurezza, in particolare durante i lavori con macchinari o in altezza.

Profilo

- Esperienza: da 3 a 5 anni di esperienza nella manutenzione professionale di giardini e spazi verdi.
- Conoscenza delle piante: buona padronanza delle piante, della loro cura e delle loro esigenze specifiche, nonché della potatura di siepi e aiuole in diverse forme.
- Autonomia e rigore: capacità di organizzare e realizzare le mansioni di manutenzione in modo autonomo e rigoroso.
- Patente di guida.
- Predisposizione al lavoro sul campo: profilo orientato al "lavoro pratico", disponibile per un lavoro fisico e all'aperto tutto l'anno.
- Spirito di squadra: buona collaborazione con gli altri membri del team paesaggistico e facilità nel seguire le istruzioni tecniche. Capacità di trasmettere il proprio know-how e di accompagnare i collaboratori meno esperti.
- Formazione lavori in altezza / motosega: un vantaggio apprezzato: i certificati SUVA "Lavori in altezza" (accesso agli alberi, utilizzo dell'imbracatura anticaduta) e/o "Uso della motosega" sono un plus per i lavori di sfoltimento, potatura in altezza o manutenzione di tetti verdi.

Cosa offriamo

- Un ruolo sul campo, concreto, all'interno di un piccolo team interno dedicato agli spazi verdi del sito.
- Uno stipendio attrattivo in base all'esperienza e alle competenze tecniche.
- Gli orari di lavoro possono variare in base alle esigenze operative e ai requisiti stagionali. Il lavoro si svolge prevalentemente all'aperto, salvo condizioni climatiche avverse.

Unitevi a noi!

- Il nostro successo deriva dai nostri dipendenti talentuosi e altamente qualificati.
- Una politica aziendale rispettosa e una visione a lungo termine sono le chiavi del nostro successo.
- La diversità a tutti i livelli di un'organizzazione è una forza.
- Vi proponiamo un ruolo concreto e stimolante, all'interno di un sito unico. Il vostro dossier sarà trattato con la massima discrezione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Gardener

Role

Reporting to the Landscaping Team Leader, the gardener is responsible for the day-to-day maintenance of the green and landscaped areas of the Prilly site (flower beds, shrubs, lawns, turf, street furniture). They are mostly out in the field and directly contribute to the aesthetic quality and safety of the site's outdoor areas.

Responsibilities and tasks

- Routine maintenance: mowing, trimming of hedges and shrubs, weeding, watering, collecting leaves and green waste.
- Specialised pruning: autonomous execution of training pruning, crown reduction and rejuvenation pruning on various shrubs, perennials and hedges, respecting seasonal cycles.
- Lawn and soil management: diagnosing lawn problems (moss, diseases, thatch) and carrying out maintenance plans (scarification, fertilisation, overseeding).
- Planting: setting up and maintaining flower beds and plants according to the plans defined by the Team Leader in agreement with the landscaping principal.
- Winter service: participation in snow clearing and salting of the site's roads and paths.
- Equipment maintenance: safe operation of machines and tools, daily technical maintenance (mowers, hedge trimmers, chainsaws, leaf blowers, etc.).
- Efficient site organisation: following the schedule and tidying equipment, leaving the site clean and safe at the end of the day.
- Safety: strict compliance with safety instructions, particularly when working with machinery or at height.

Profile

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in professional garden and green space maintenance.
- Plant knowledge: good command of plants, their care and specific needs, as well as hedge and bed pruning in various forms.
- Autonomy and rigour: ability to organise and carry out maintenance tasks autonomously and rigorously.
- Driving licence.
- Field-oriented mindset: a hands-on profile, available for physical, outdoor work all year round.
- Team spirit: good collaboration with other members of the landscaping team and ease in following technical instructions. Ability to share know-how and support less experienced colleagues.
- Working at height / chainsaw training: an appreciated asset: SUVA certificates for "Working at height" (tree access, wearing a fall-arrest harness) and/or "Chainsaw handling" are a plus for pruning, working at height or maintaining green roofs.

What we offer

- A hands-on, field-based role within a small internal team dedicated to the site's green spaces.
- An attractive salary based on experience and technical skills.
- Working hours may vary depending on operational needs and seasonal requirements. Work is carried out mainly outdoors, subject to weather conditions.

Join us!

- Our success comes from our talented and highly skilled employees.
- A respectful corporate policy and a long-term vision are the keys to our success.
- Diversity at all levels of an organisation is a strength.
- We offer you a concrete and stimulating role, within a unique site. Your application will be treated with the utmost discretion.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Gärtner/in

Rolle

Dem Teamleiter Landschaftsgärtnerei unterstellt, ist der/die Gärtner/in für die tägliche Pflege der Grün- und Landschaftsflächen am Standort Prilly verantwortlich (Blumenbeete, Sträucher, Rasenflächen, Stadtmobiliar). Er/sie ist überwiegend im Einsatz vor Ort und trägt direkt zur ästhetischen Qualität und Sicherheit der Aussenbereiche des Standorts bei.

Verantwortlichkeiten und Aufgaben

- Laufende Pflege: Mähen, Schneiden von Hecken und Sträuchern, Unkrautentfernung, Bewässerung, Aufsammeln von Laub und Grünabfällen.
- Spezialisierter Schnitt: selbstständige Durchführung von Formschnitten, Auslichtungen und Verjüngungsschnitten an verschiedenen Sträuchern, Stauden und Hecken unter Berücksichtigung der saisonalen Zyklen.
- Rasen- und Bodenpflege: Diagnose von Rasenproblemen (Moos, Krankheiten, Filz) und Umsetzung der Pflegepläne (Vertikutieren, Düngen, Nachsäen).
- Bepflanzungen: Anlage und Pflege von Blumenbeeten und Pflanzen gemäss den vom Teamleiter in Absprache mit dem Auftraggeber der Landschaftsgärtnerei festgelegten Plänen.
- Winterdienst: Beteiligung am Schneeräumen und Salzen der Strassen und Wege des Standorts.
- Geräteunterhalt: sichere Nutzung von Maschinen und Werkzeugen, tägliche technische Wartung (Rasenmäher, Heckenscheren, Motorsägen, Laubbläser usw.).
- Effiziente Baustellenorganisation: Einhaltung des Zeitplans und Aufräumen der Geräte, sodass der Standort am Ende des Tages sauber und sicher hinterlassen wird.
- Sicherheit: strikte Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften, insbesondere bei Arbeiten mit Maschinen oder in der Höhe.

Profil

- Erfahrung: 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Pflege von Gärten und Grünflächen.
- Pflanzenkenntnisse: gute Beherrschung von Pflanzen, deren Pflege und spezifischen Bedürfnissen sowie des Hecken- und Beetschnitts in verschiedenen Formen.
- Selbstständigkeit und Sorgfalt: Fähigkeit, Pflegeaufgaben selbstständig und sorgfältig zu organisieren und durchzuführen.
- Führerschein.
- Freude an der Arbeit im Freien: ein praxisorientiertes Profil, das bereit ist, das ganze Jahr über körperlich und im Freien zu arbeiten.
- Teamgeist: gute Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen Mitgliedern des Landschaftsgärtnerei-Teams und die Fähigkeit, technischen Anweisungen zu folgen. Fähigkeit, sein Know-how weiterzugeben und weniger erfahrene Mitarbeitende zu begleiten.
- Ausbildung für Arbeiten in der Höhe / Motorsäge: ein geschätzter Vorteil: SUVA-Zertifikate für „Arbeiten in der Höhe" (Baumzugang, Tragen eines Auffanggurts) und/oder „Umgang mit der Motorsäge" sind ein Plus für Auslichtungsarbeiten, Höhenschnitt oder die Pflege von begrünten Dächern.

Was wir bieten

- Eine konkrete Tätigkeit im Freien innerhalb eines kleinen internen Teams, das den Grünflächen des Standorts gewidmet ist.
- Ein attraktives Gehalt je nach Erfahrung und technischen Kompetenzen.
- Die Arbeitszeiten können je nach operativen Bedürfnissen und saisonalen Anforderungen variieren. Die Arbeit wird überwiegend im Freien ausgeführt, vorbehaltlich der Wetterbedingungen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams!

- Unser Erfolg beruht auf unseren talentierten und hochqualifizierten Mitarbeitenden.
- Eine respektvolle Unternehmenspolitik und eine langfristige Vision sind die Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg.
- Vielfalt auf allen Ebenen einer Organisation ist eine Stärke.
- Wir bieten Ihnen eine konkrete und stimulierende Rolle an einem einzigartigen Standort. Ihre Bewerbung wird mit höchster Diskretion behandelt.

jobs.title: Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
As a Delivery Lead, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of innovative digital solutions for government and institutional customers. Acting as the bridge between customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams, you will ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope and budget, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams to transform complex requirements and data into operational capabilities and actionable insights.

ROLE

• Lead the delivery of bespoke digital solutions for governments and institutional clients, with a focus on AI sovereignty and technology neutrality.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across Software Development (Back-end, Front-end, DevOps, UX/UI), Business Intelligence, and Data Science to transform complex data into actionable insights.

• Orchestrate Sovereign Data, Intelligence Analysis, and OSINT activities to collect, enrich, and analyze information, enabling informed decision-making.

• Capture and channel demand for new projects and product developments.

• Identify opportunities for commercial expansion and additional value creation within existing customer engagements, collaborating with commercial teams to support cross-selling and upselling initiatives.

• Propose solutions with associated effort and cost estimates, ensuring alignment with solution roadmaps and existing platforms.

• Conduct meetings with customers, partners, and key stakeholders.

• Maintain and regularly communicate delivery plans to internal stakeholders.

• Organize work packages and define key milestones to ensure effective coordination across delivery teams.

• Ensure successful delivery of solutions according to project requirements, timelines, budget, and quality expectations.

• Align delivery plans with project timelines and priorities through the project core team.

• Maintain project management tools and documentation up to date.

PROFILE

• Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, or equivalent.

• Proven experience in the delivery of software and digital solutions is required.

• Experience working with government and institutional clients.

• Exposure to Data Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Statistics.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to understand customer needs, identify growth opportunities, and translate them into value-added solution proposals.

• Strong project management skills; PMP or HERMES certification is considered an asset.

• Scrum Master and/or Product Owner certification is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• International exposure and willingness to travel.

• Good understanding of Agile ways of working and ability to balance Agile delivery with contractual commitments.

• Strong analytical skills, with an autonomous, curious, trustworthy, and results-oriented mindset.

• Team player able to thrive in a multicultural environment while working independently when needed.

• Fluent in English and French.

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

• Monitor project actuals against planned budgets and escalate risks where appropriate.

Ruolo

- Guidare la consegna di soluzioni digitali su misura per governi e clienti istituzionali, con un focus sulla sovranità dell'IA e sulla neutralità tecnologica.
- Coordinare team trasversali tra Sviluppo Software (Back-end, Front-end, DevOps, UX/UI), Business Intelligence e Data Science per trasformare dati complessi in informazioni actionable.
- Orchestrare le attività di Sovereign Data, Intelligence Analysis e OSINT per raccogliere, arricchire e analizzare informazioni, consentendo un processo decisionale informato.
- Cogliere e indirizzare la domanda per nuovi progetti e sviluppi di prodotto.
- Identificare opportunità di espansione commerciale e di creazione di valore aggiuntivo all'interno delle relazioni con i clienti esistenti, collaborando con i team commerciali per supportare iniziative di cross-selling e up-selling.
- Proporre soluzioni con relative stime di impegno e costo, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap delle soluzioni e le piattaforme esistenti.
- Condurre riunioni con clienti, partner e stakeholder chiave.
- Mantenere e comunicare regolarmente i piani di consegna agli stakeholder interni.
- Organizzare i pacchetti di lavoro e definire le milestone chiave per garantire un coordinamento efficace tra i team di delivery.
- Garantire la consegna efficace delle soluzioni in base ai requisiti, alle tempistiche, al budget e alle aspettative di qualità del progetto.
- Allineare i piani di consegna con le tempistiche e le priorità del progetto attraverso il core team di progetto.
- Mantenere aggiornati gli strumenti e la documentazione di project management.

Profilo

- Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Sistemi Informativi, Business Information Technology o equivalente.
- È richiesta esperienza comprovata nella consegna di soluzioni software e digitali.
- Esperienza di lavoro con clienti governativi e istituzionali.
- Esperienza in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics o Statistica.
- Forte acume commerciale con capacità di comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, identificare opportunità di crescita e tradurle in proposte di soluzioni a valore aggiunto.
- Forti capacità di project management; la certificazione PMP o HERMES è considerata un plus.
- La certificazione Scrum Master e/o Product Owner è un vantaggio.
- Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
- Esperienza internazionale e disponibilità a viaggiare.
- Buona comprensione delle modalità di lavoro Agile e capacità di bilanciare la delivery Agile con gli impegni contrattuali.
- Forti capacità analitiche, con mentalità autonoma, curiosa, affidabile e orientata ai risultati.
- Team player in grado di eccellere in un ambiente multiculturale lavorando in modo indipendente quando necessario.
- Fluente in inglese e francese.

Perché unirsi a noi?

- Unisciti a un leader globale nelle tecnologie di fiducia con una missione che conta.
- Sii nel cuore strategico di un'azienda finanziariamente solida e orientata all'innovazione.
- Collabora con esperti di alto livello e lavora su progetti internazionali di grande impatto.
- Opera in un ambiente multiculturale e ad alta integrità dove autonomia e responsabilità sono incoraggiate.
- Monitorare i dati effettivi del progetto rispetto ai budget pianificati e segnalare i rischi quando appropriato.

Descrizione

Come Delivery Lead, sarai responsabile della consegna efficace di soluzioni digitali innovative per clienti governativi e istituzionali. Fungendo da ponte tra clienti, stakeholder di business e team tecnici, garantirai che le soluzioni vengano consegnate nei tempi, nel rispetto dello scope e del budget, mantenendo i più alti standard di qualità e soddisfazione del cliente. Coordinerai team multidisciplinari per trasformare requisiti e dati complessi in capacità operative e informazioni actionable.

jobs.title: Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Partnerships Director, the Partnerships Coordinator will provide day-to-day operational support in managing and optimizing the Group's interests across private joint venture (JV) companies. These JVs are private-to-private alliances formed specifically to develop and capture Business-to-Government (B2G) market opportunities.

The Partnerships Coordinator will act as the operational anchor, ensuring smooth collaboration between SICPA and its private local partners as they jointly deploy SICPA solutions to government clients.

ROLE

JV and Partnership Governance & Compliance

• Track obligations and deliverables arising from private shareholder agreements, resource-sharing pacts and non-disclosure agreements (NDAs).

• Prepare operational dashboards, briefing notes and status updates for the Partnerships Director ahead of JV, steering committee and alignment meetings.

• Organize, document and follow up on action items, decisions and open points arising from JV, steering committee and alignment meetings.

Private Alliance Coordination

• Ensure a clear division of responsibilities between both private parties regarding B2G target pursuits.

• Facilitate the collection and sharing of technical knowledge, marketing assets and product updates from Headquarters to local partners' commercial teams.

• Proactively flag delays, missing inputs, misalignments or sensitive topics requiring management attention.

• Draft, structure and coordinate communications with internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Maintain organized records, action logs, decision trackers and open-point lists for recurring partnership topics.

Due Diligence and Ventures Coordination

• Coordinate due diligence activities in the context of potential acquisitions of majority and minority shareholdings.

• Interact with internal stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Legal & IP, HR and Finance functions to ensure the delivery of standardized and comprehensive reports supporting decision-making.

• Facilitate SICPA's representation as a shareholder in minority stakes acquired in the past.

• Assess the potential of current ventures and propose alternatives to maximize their value.

PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Corporate Law or a related field.

• 2 to 4 years of professional experience in partnership management, alliance operations or corporate project management.

• Direct experience in B2B2G models, channel partnerships or private consortiums targeting public sector contracts is highly desirable.

• Ability to navigate the collaborative and competitive dimensions of private-to-private business partnerships.

• Understanding of public procurement environments, including long sales cycles, compliance requirements and associated risks.

• Strong project management skills with a proven ability to track deliverables across multiple corporate entities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with senior stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, complete and well-organized documentation.

• Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate follow-up needs, prepare topics in advance and escalate risks when required.

• Sound judgment in handling confidential partner information and governance documentation.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams and SharePoint.

• Comfortable using AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot to support drafting, research, summarization, information organization and preparation of reports and presentations while ensuring appropriate handling of confidential information.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Limited travel initially, with potential for growth based on partnership needs.

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

jobs.description:
ROLE

•    Strengthen observability and diagnostics for SDKs and reference apps using Splunk and other tools (logs, metrics, crash signals, field diagnostics).
•    Build and own engineering tooling and automation, and define a multi-quarter platform roadmap, to measurably reduce operational workload and increase developer productivity at scale across the team (~20 engineers), while reducing integration and support effort.
•    Design, implement, and maintain Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery pipelines and quality gates (Jenkins) for mobile SDKs (build, test, packaging, release validation, regression detection).
•    Develop release qualification frameworks: automated functional tests, performance benchmarks, compatibility checks, and reproducible test environments.
•    Deliver and evolve core components of mobile SDKs (iOS, Android): camera capture, image processing pipelines, API design, modularization, documentation, smartphone apps.
•    Provide technical leadership as an Individual Contributor (no management): architecture decisions, design reviews, mentoring through code reviews, and raising engineering standards.
•    Lead the integration of AI/ML into the mobile detection stack, from rapid prototyping to production-grade deployment on iOS/Android.
•    Build an AI-driven validation and triage layer for SDK releases, including automated regression and anomaly detection.

PROFILE

•    Principal Engineer with a strong track record of delivering production software.
•    Proven experience building developer tooling / automation platforms that measurably improve team productivity (e.g., faster releases, fewer regressions, reduced support load).
•    Strong iOS expertise: Swift, Xcode, SDK design and packaging, performance profiling (Instruments); Objective C is a plus.
•    Solid Android foundations: Kotlin/Java, Gradle, CameraX/Camera2, instrumentation/testing; ability to support and debug across both platforms.
•    Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts and implementation experience with Jenkins (pipelines, build/test orchestration, quality gates, artifacts, release processes).
•    Strong knowledge of software architecture, API design, testing strategy, secure coding practices, and maintaining high-quality codebases.
•    Hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision / image processing pipelines on mobile devices and under real-world constraints (latency, memory, device variability).
•    Strong problem‑solving skills, translating customer needs into scalable solutions.
•    Hands‑on experience deploying AI/ML models to production on resource‑constrained, heterogeneous devices.
•    Solid expertise in the full ML lifecycle, including data quality, evaluation, robustness, and model release management.
•    Practical experience with on-device ML toolchains and runtimes and performance engineering under real device constraints.
•    Ability to define and enforce AI usage standards in an industrial environment.
•    Strong communication and collaboration skills in multicultural environments; fluent English, French is a strong plus.

WHY JOIN US?

•    Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.
•    Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.
•    Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.
•    Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

jobs.title: Technicien de Maintenance
jobs.description:
Afin de renforcer notre département Facilities & Services chez SICPA, nous recherchons un(e):

Technicien de maintenance

Mission générale

Le Technicien de maintenance assure de manière autonome et proactive l’exploitation, la maintenance, le dépannage et le suivi des infrastructures techniques du site de Florissant, comprenant notamment les installations desservant les laboratoires, le Data Center et les infrastructures générales du site. Il est responsable des installations techniques depuis leur production jusqu’à leur distribution ou point de raccordement aux équipements utilisateurs, dans le respect des règles de sécurité, des normes et des prescriptions en vigueur.

Domaines techniques concernés:

Électricité

• Production et distribution électrique du site.

• Maintenance et dépannage des installations électriques jusqu’au point de raccordement.

• Intervention selon les compétences et autorisations requises.

Sanitaire et chauffage

• Production et distribution de chaleur et d’eau.

• Maintenance des réseaux, pompes, vannes et installations associées.

• Diagnostic et dépannage des installations.

Production et distribution de froid

• Production de froid et installations associées.

• Réseaux et circuits de distribution.

• Pompes, vannes et équipements périphériques.

• Suivi des paramètres de fonctionnement et dépannage.

Ventilation

• Exploitation et maintenance des installations de ventilation et d’extraction d’air.

• Ventilation des locaux, notamment des laboratoires et des zones techniques.

• Suivi des débits, températures, pressions et paramètres de fonctionnement.

Air comprimé

• Production et distribution d’air comprimé.

• Maintenance des compresseurs et réseaux de distribution.

• Surveillance des installations et recherche d’anomalies ou de fuites.

Automation et supervision

• Exploitation et suivi des systèmes d’automation et de supervision des infrastructures techniques.

• Surveillance des alarmes et des paramètres des installations.

• Diagnostic des défauts et interventions dans la limite des compétences et autorisations.

Autonomie et organisation

Le Technicien de maintenance travaille de manière autonome et organise son activité quotidienne en fonction des priorités, des urgences et des besoins du site.

Il assure le suivi des interventions, identifie les anomalies et propose des solutions adaptées. Il collabore avec les entreprises externes ou les spécialistes lorsque les compétences nécessaires dépassent son périmètre d’intervention.

Service de piquet

Participation au service de piquet environ une fois par mois, lorsque l’effectif de l’équipe est au complet, afin d’assurer la continuité de fonctionnement des infrastructures techniques des trois sites : Florissant, Campus et Bussigny.

Responsabilité principale

Le Technicien de maintenance contribue directement à la disponibilité, à la fiabilité, à la sécurité et à la pérennité des infrastructures techniques, dans son domaine de compétence et jusqu’aux points de distribution ou de raccordement.

PROFIL:

Formation et expérience

• Formation technique dans le domaine de la maintenance, de l’électricité, du CVC ou formation équivalente.

• Expérience confirmée dans la maintenance d’infrastructures et d’installations techniques.

• Bonnes connaissances dans plusieurs domaines techniques : électricité, ventilation, chauffage, sanitaire, froid, air comprimé et automation.

• Titulaire d’une autorisation d’électricien selon l’Art. 13 OIBT. À défaut, titulaire au minimum d’une autorisation selon l’Art. 15 OIBT ou remplissant les conditions pour l’obtenir.

• Une expérience dans un environnement laboratoire, industriel ou Data Center constitue un avantage.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des pannes de manière autonome.

• Bonne compréhension des installations techniques et de leurs interactions.

• Capacité à intervenir sur des installations complexes et à analyser les causes d’un dysfonctionnement.

• Connaissances des systèmes d’automation et de supervision.

• Capacité à effectuer des interventions préventives, correctives et curatives.

• Aptitude à travailler avec des entreprises externes et des spécialistes lorsque nécessaire.

Qualités personnelles

• Autonomie et sens des responsabilités.

• Capacité à s’auto-organiser et à gérer les priorités.

• Esprit d’analyse et orientation solutions.

• Esprit pratique et capacité à prendre des initiatives.

• Rigueur et fiabilité.

• Bonne capacité à travailler seul comme en équipe.

• Bonne communication avec les utilisateurs, les collègues, les fournisseurs et les entreprises externes.

• Sensibilité élevée aux aspects sécurité, qualité et continuité de service.

• Disponibilité pour participer au service de piquet.

REJOIGNEZ-NOUS!

• Notre succès provient de nos employés talentueux et hautement qualifiés.

• Une politique d’entreprise respectueuse et une vision à long terme sont les clés de notre réussite.

• La diversité à tous les niveaux d'une organisation est une force.

• Nous vous proposons un rôle passionnant et stimulant, dans une entreprise qui offre de belles perspectives de carrière et cela dans un environnement unique et absolument passionnant.

Votre dossier sera traité avec la plus grande discrétion.

• Aufschlüsselung der Räumlichkeiten, einschließlich Laboratorien und technischer Bereiche.

• Überwachung von Anlagen und Suche nach Anomalien oder Lecks.

jobs.description:
To strengthen our DIGITAL R&I department, we are looking for a:

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer who is passionate about cloud-native technologies, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and enjoys designing, delivering, and operating modern cloud platforms that empower development teams and business solutions.

Your Responsibilities

• Architect, develop and operate cloud platform capabilities and core infrastructure services.

• Contribute to the definition and execution of the platform's technical and functional roadmap.

• Design and implement Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to enable consistent, scalable, and automated deployments across cloud and on-premises environments.

• Build, maintain and optimize CI/CD platforms, pipelines and automation frameworks supporting software delivery at scale.

• Design and implement cloud operational best practices, including monitoring, observability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.

• Develop and maintain platform services, automation tooling, and operational capabilities using modern software engineering practices.

• Apply software engineering best practices, including automated testing, peer code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, and product teams to improve platform adoption and developer experience.

• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, platform planning, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support the deployment and operation of cloud-native platforms, data services, and infrastructure components.

Your Profile

• BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proven experience as a Cloud Platform Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent role.

• Strong experience deploying and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms.

• Experience with one or more major public cloud providers such as Azure, AWS, or equivalent cloud technologies.

• Strong programming and automation skills in Python and shell scripting.

• Ability to understand, troubleshoot and collaborate on solutions developed in languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Groovy or similar.

• Experience building and maintaining container images and Kubernetes ecosystem components, including Helm and Operators.

• Experience designing and operating CI/CD platforms, workflows, and deployment automation.

• Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management technologies such as Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Ansible.

• Experience operating cloud-native data and messaging platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies.

• Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems concepts.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration across teams.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and modern software delivery practices.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

JOIN US !

• Our success comes from our highly skilled and talented employees.

• Respectful entrepreneurship and long-term vision are key for success.

• Our people contribute to a more secure world.

• Diversity at all levels of an organisation is a strength.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.
